title: Build a goal ladder (push and pull)
summary: Easy goals first to build momentum, then step the amounts down, not up.
details: Raising the ask on every goal tires the room. Start with quick wins, put the big goal early while energy is high, then make each next goal a little easier.
steps: Open with 1–2 easy warm-up goals the room can hit fast.
Place the main (biggest) goal next, while momentum is high.
Step the next goals down in amount.
Keep 2 backup goals ready for slow moments.
goalLadder: Main goal · the biggest ask of the night

title: Token ranges
summary: Example ranges only. Your TL sets the real numbers for each room.
tips: Bigger rooms can carry bigger goals. Match the ask to traffic and pace.
Replace these ranges with the team's agreed numbers.

title: Main vs backup goals, and when to switch
summary: Plan 4 main goals and 2 backups. Check the room before lowering a stalled goal.
steps: Main goals: the planned path for the stream, in push-and-pull order.
Backup goals: no fixed order. Pick the one that fits the moment.
If a goal stalls, check traffic, engagement and pace first.
Traffic strong but tips weak? Shift to conversion. Don't beg for the goal.
Still stuck? Switch to a backup or a filler, and tell your TL why.
tips: A goal that stalls far from target usually means viewers don't believe it can be hit. Show progress or make it smaller.
